title: Permission for development or for construction
text: 12. Permission for development or for construction.-(1) Development or construction not to be without permission. No person shall carry out any development or erect, re-erect or make alterations or demolish any building or cause the same to be done without obtaining a prior permission in writing in this regard from the Authority: Provided that no permission shall be required for specified works including opening or closing a window or door, partitions, false ceilings, gardening, white washing, painting, re-tiling and repairing of roof, plastering and patch work, re-flooring and other stated exceptions. Rule 12(3): Both the permission for development and also the permission for building shall be necessary for commencement of building activities involving development of land as a composite building scheme.

title: Permission of farm House
text: 17. Permission of farm House.- In any area designated for agricultural use, Farm Houses shall be permissible subject to the following conditions and such other conditions as may be imposed by the authority: (a) Minimum size of the plot shall be 0.40 hectare; (b) Maximum F.A.R. shall be 0.10; (c) maximum height shall be 7.5 meters with sloping roof; (d) minimum 100 live trees per hectare; (e) accessible by road having width not less than 7.5 meters; (f) minimum 7.50 meters open space from all sides. 17-a. Agricultural tourist facility has separate conditions in the source text.

title: Duration of sanction
text: 23. Duration of sanction.- (1) In case of development permission under Section 30 of Madhya Pradesh Nagar Tatha Gram Nivesh Adhiniyam, 1973 the sanction once accorded shall remain valid up to three years. (2) The permission shall be got revalidated if it expires. Such revalidation may be permitted for two consecutive terms of one year each, after which proposals shall be submitted afresh. The five-year limitation shall not be relaxed. (3) If execution of the project begins during validity of the permission granted under Section 30 of the Act, the permission shall not be deemed to lapse thereafter and no revalidation shall be required.

title: Distance from electric lines
text: 52. Distance from electric lines.- (1) The minimum distance between the building and any overhead electric supply line shall be as mentioned below or in applicable Electricity Rules, whichever is more. Table: Low and Medium voltage lines and service lines: vertical 2.5 meters, horizontal 1.2 meters. High voltage lines up to and including 33000 volts: vertical 3.7 meters, horizontal 1.2 meters. Extra high voltage lines beyond 33000 volts: provide a clear horizontal corridor of 15 meters (7.5 meter open on both sides of centre line), or as specified in applicable Electricity Rules, whichever is more. Clearances are measured from maximum sag vertically and maximum deflection due to wind pressure horizontally.

title: Residential Buildings
text: 56. Residential Buildings.-Open Spaces,- Exterior open spaces for buildings having height up to 12.5 meters. Front open spaces: Every residential building having height up to 12.5 meters and facing a street shall have front open space: street width up to 9.0 meters = minimum 3.0 meters; more than 9.0 meters and up to 12 meters = minimum 3.6 meters; more than 12.0 meters and up to 18 meters = minimum 4.5 meters; above 18 meters = minimum 6.0 meters. In existing developed areas with streets less than 6.0 meters wide, the building line shall be 6.0 meters from the centre line of the street. Rear open space for residential building height up to 12.5 meters: plot area up to 40 square meters = Nil; above 40 and up to 150 square meters = 1.50 meters; above 150 and up to 225 square meters = 2.50 meters; above 225 square meters = 3.00 meters. Every detached building shall have minimum side open spaces of 3 meters on both sides, provided that for detached residential buildings up to 7 meters in height on plots with frontage less than 12 meters, one side open space may be reduced to 1.5 meters. For semi-detached buildings minimum side open space is 3 meters on one side, subject to the conditions stated in the rule. Row-type buildings need no side open space under this provision. For buildings above 12.5 meters, open spaces are given in Tables 4 and 5 of Rule 42. Interior open spaces, courtyards and ventilation shafts are also governed by Rule 56.
